text_block_list.text:
Маяно Топ Ган runs with all she's got,
but she
ultimately loses to Нарита Брайан.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Still, she enjoyed the race so much she
can't
contain her excitement.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She also realizes that Нарита Брайан is not
yet
satisfied, so...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She decides to give her yet another
exciting bout
at the Hanshin Daishoten.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
